name: Buyout
description: Buys out one failing enemy, at half Resolve or less, once per battle. It works your side for two rounds, then walks off the field. Bosses are not for sale.

name: Equity
description: Takes the field's attention for two turns and absorbs what comes. Everything they spend on him is a position he is building.

name: Acquisition
description: Takes whatever the target is currently enjoying and enjoys it instead.

name: Majority
description: Calls the whole side onto his book. Everyone recovers, and the gauge fills.

name: Hostile Takeover
description: Capstone. Returns everything that has been done to him, at once, to one target. The more he has taken, the larger the position.
